# Project Instructions

Use the Hallmark design rules for frontend work in this project.

The complete Hallmark skill is maintained at [skills/hallmark/SKILL.md](../skills/hallmark/SKILL.md). Read and apply it for design, audit, redesign, and study requests, including its safety rails, responsive requirements, typography rules, interaction states, token discipline, and validation steps.

For audit requests, do not edit files. For redesign requests, preserve existing copy, data, functionality, routes, and JavaScript hooks unless the user explicitly asks otherwise. Before editing, state the exact files to create or modify.
